CreateAnnualDocSummaryTask.description_en: Create a task to summarize documents by year
CreateAnnualDocSummaryTask.description_zh: 创建按年份总结文档任务

CreateDialogAnalysisTask.description_en: Creates a session analysis task. After the task is created, use the session ID with GetDialogAnalysisResult to retrieve the results
CreateDialogAnalysisTask.description_zh: 创建会话分析任务，创建成功后可根据会话ID使用GetDialogAnalysisResult查询结果

CreateLibrary.description_en: Creates a document library. A document library isolates document and index data. If your use case requires frequent natural language search by category, create multiple libraries to isolate different data types. You can customize vector and text indexes by format
CreateLibrary.description_zh: 创建文档库。创建一个新的文档库，文档库用作隔离文档信息、索引信息，如果使用场景中需要经常按类别去做自然语言检索，建议创建多个文档库，来隔离不同类型的数据。支持按照格式自定义向量索引和文本索引

CreatePdfTranslateTask.description_en: Create a PDF document translation task. Submit the task to start asynchronous translation
CreatePdfTranslateTask.description_zh: 创建pdf文档翻译任务。提交翻译任务，异步执行翻译过程

CreatePredefinedDocument.description_en: Creates document chunks based on your business scenarios
CreatePredefinedDocument.description_zh: 根据业务场景灵活构建文档块

DashscopeAsyncTaskFinishEvent.description_en: A callback event that indicates the completion of a Dashscope asynchronous task
DashscopeAsyncTaskFinishEvent.description_zh: Dashscope异步任务完成回调事件

DeleteDocument.description_en: Deletes a document. After deletion, you cannot view the original document or recall it
DeleteDocument.description_zh: 删除文档，删除后将无法查看原始文档，无法召回该文档

DeleteLibrary.description_en: Delete a document library. ⚠️ This operation deletes the library and all its associated documents
DeleteLibrary.description_zh: 删除文档库，注意⚠️，此接口将会删除文档库及其关联的所有文档

EndToEndRealTimeDialog.description_en: This API uses the WebSocket protocol to perform real-time conversational transcription, intent recognition, and speech synthesis. It supports various audio formats for both input and output to ensure real-time performance and high compatibility
EndToEndRealTimeDialog.description_zh: 本接口通过 WebSocket 协议实现实时语音对话转写、意图识别、话术语音合成返回等功能，支持多种音频格式的输入输出，满足实时性与高兼容性需求

GenDocQaResult.description_en: Parses question and answer (Q&A) pairs from a document. You can use the UpdateQaLibrary API to update the Q&A pairs
GenDocQaResult.description_zh: 根据文档解析问答QA，可在API UpdateQaLibrary进行QA对的更新

GetChatQuestionResp.description_en: Retrieves the Q&A results generated by the SubmitChatQuestion API
GetChatQuestionResp.description_zh: 获取问答结果，即API SubmitChatQuestion的结果

GetDialogAnalysisResult.description_en: Retrieve session analysis results. You can retrieve results in batches by specifying a list of session IDs or a time range
GetDialogAnalysisResult.description_zh: 获取会话分析结果。可批量获取，根据会话ID列表或时间范围

GetDialogLog.description_en: Retrieves records of real-time conversations and the results of intent analysis
GetDialogLog.description_zh: 用于获取实时对话的记录及意图分析结果

GetDocumentChunkList.description_en: Retrieve a list of document chunks. You can filter them by query conditions
GetDocumentChunkList.description_zh: 获取文档块列表，可根据查询条件过滤

GetDocumentList.description_en: Retrieves a list of documents from a document library. This operation supports paged queries and filtering by document status
GetDocumentList.description_zh: 获取文档库内文档列表，可分页查询，也根据文档状态进行过滤查询

GetDocumentUrl.description_en: Retrieve a download URL for a document. The URL expires after 1 hour
GetDocumentUrl.description_zh: 获取文档的下载链接，链接过期时间为1小时

GetFilterDocumentList.description_en: This operation retrieves a list of documents. You can filter documents by metadata or use paging
GetFilterDocumentList.description_zh: 获取文档列表（可按元信息过滤查询，也支持分页查询）

GetHistoryListByBizType.description_en: Retrieve conversation history records by business type
GetHistoryListByBizType.description_zh: 根据业务类型获取对话历史记录

GetLibrary.description_en: Retrieves the detailed configuration of a document library, including its name, description, and index settings
GetLibrary.description_zh: 查看文档库的详细配置，包括文档库名称、描述以及索引等详细配置信息

GetLibraryList.description_en: Retrieve the document library list. The list includes document names, descriptions, and unique identifiers
GetLibraryList.description_zh: 获取文档库列表，包含文档名称、描述、唯一标识等信息

GetParseResult.description_en: Retrieve document parsing results. You can query the document's parsing status and obtain the parsing results
GetParseResult.description_zh: 获取文档解析结果。可查询文档的解析状态以及获取文档的解析结果

GetSummaryTaskResult.description_en: Retrieves the result of a financial report summary task
GetSummaryTaskResult.description_zh: 获取财报总结任务结果

GetTaskResult.description_en: Retrieves the result of an asynchronous task

GetTaskStatus.description_en: Gets the status of a task

InvokePlugin.description_en: Call a plugin and retrieve its response
InvokePlugin.description_zh: 调用插件，获取插件返回结果

PreviewDocument.description_en: Preview documents. Retrieve document download links, types, and titles. Use this operation to preview documents
PreviewDocument.description_zh: 预览文档，可获取文档的下载链接，文档类型、标题等信息，可用于文档预览

ReIndex.description_en: Reindexing reprocesses the specified document by parsing it, splitting it into chunks, and building a new index
ReIndex.description_zh: 重建索引，会对指定文档重新进行文档解析、分块、构建索引等流程

RealTimeDialog.description_en: Starts a real-time session. After you create a session by calling the CreateDialog API, use this API to conduct the real-time interaction
RealTimeDialog.description_zh: 实时会话，通过API CreateDialog创建会话后，可使用该API进行实时会话

RealtimeDialogAssist.description_en: Provides real-time dialog assistance after a session is created using CreateDialog. Note: This operation returns multiple intents, tags, and SOP flows. Unlike real-time sessions, it does not support streaming responses
RealtimeDialogAssist.description_zh: 实时会话辅助，使用CreateDialog创建会话后，可进行实时的会话辅助。注意：与实时会话不同，会话辅助可返回多个意图、标签和SOP流程等，但不支持流式返回

RebuildTask.description_en: Rebuilds an existing task. You cannot rebuild tasks that are queued or currently executing
RebuildTask.description_zh: 对已有任务进行重建，但在队列中或执行中的任务不可重建

RecallDocument.description_en: You can retrieve document chunks from a document library using text. You can specify the number of chunks to retrieve, filter them by metadata conditions, and choose whether to complete the document chunks
RecallDocument.description_zh: 文档召回，可根据文本从文档库中召回文档块。并可设置召回文档块数量、也可根据元信息条件进行过滤，同时可选择是否进行文档块的补全

RecognizeIntention.description_en: Detects intents. This operation supports global and hierarchical intent detection, attitude detection, and enterprise detection
RecognizeIntention.description_zh: 意图识别，支持意图识别（全局+分层）、态度识别、企业识别

RunAgent.description_en: Run an agent. This API supports both streaming and non-streaming responses
RunAgent.description_zh: 运行智能体，支持流式和非流式

RunChatResultGeneration.description_en: Generates chat responses. You can select a model for the conversation and choose streaming or non-streaming output
RunChatResultGeneration.description_zh: 对话结果生成，可选择模型进行对话，支持流式和非流式

RunDialogAnalysis.description_en: Retrieves session analysis results through a streaming API
RunDialogAnalysis.description_zh: 流式接口，获取会话分析结果

RunLibraryChatGeneration.description_en: Generates a chat response from a document library. You can ask questions in natural language, and the system retrieves relevant information to provide a summarized answer
RunLibraryChatGeneration.description_zh: 文档库会话生成，用自然语言提问，检索文档库相关信息，总结回答

SubmitChatQuestion.description_en: Submit a list of questions and retrieve results by calling the `GetChatQuestionResp` API
SubmitChatQuestion.description_zh: 提交问题列表，通过API GetChatQuestionResp获取结果

UpdateDocument.description_en: Updates the title, metadata, and other information of a document
UpdateDocument.description_zh: 更新文档，用于更新文档的标题、元数据等信息

UpdateDocumentChunk.description_en: Update the text content of a document chunk in a document
UpdateDocumentChunk.description_zh: 更新文档中的文档块文本内容

UpdateLibrary.description_en: Updates a document library. You can update the library name, description, and index configuration
UpdateLibrary.description_zh: 更新文档库，可用于更新文档库的名称、描述、索引配置等信息

UpdateQaLibrary.description_en: Updates a Q&A library. After the update, use the GenDocQaResult API to parse the Q&A pairs
UpdateQaLibrary.description_zh: 更新QA问答库。更新后，可通过API GenDocQaResult来解析QA

UploadDocument.description_en: Upload a document to a document library. The system parses the document, splits it into chunks, and builds an index
UploadDocument.description_zh: 上传文档至文档库，会对文档进行解析、分块、构建索引等一系列操作
